SELECT cls,
       CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bin,
       COUNT(*) AS boat_days,
       SUM(yt)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND cls IN ('DAY_1_5','THREE_QUARTER','OVERNIGHT') AND fish_date_doy >= 260
GROUP BY cls, doy_bin
ORDER BY cls, doy_bin
